ball_line_test.title: Ball-line test
steps: Draw a straight line around the ball with a Sharpie.
Hit 3–5 shots off a mat or impact board.
Check the tilt of the line left on the club face (degrees from vertical).
ball_line_test.caption: + = the line leans toward the toe

height.title: Measure your height
steps: Stand straight with your back against a wall.
Mark the wall at the top of your head and measure up from the floor.
height.caption: Round to the nearest centimetre.

wrist_to_floor.title: Measure wrist to floor
steps: Stand straight with your arms hanging down.
Measure from the crease of your wrist to the floor.
wrist_to_floor.caption: Measure the lead wrist, to the nearest centimetre.

hand_length.title: Measure your hand length
steps: Hold your hand open and flat.
Find the crease where your wrist meets your palm.
Measure from that crease to the tip of your middle finger.
hand_length.caption: Use the hand you wear the glove on.
